title: Dushman ko bhi
body:
daaghe jawan dekh ke shabbir ne kaha
dushman ko bhi khuda na dikhaye pisar ka daagh
<<DIVIDER>>
karta hoo baargah e elaahi mein ye dua
dushman ko bhi khuda na dikhaye pisar ka daagh
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ka jawan laal ho akbar sa naujawan
khud aake jiska sadqa utaare hai kehkashan
sadma koi uthaye na aise jawan ka
dushman ko bhi khuda na...
<<DIVIDER>>
bichda jawan to phir nahi jeene ki koi chaah
ta umr khoon ke ashk hi barsaati hai nigaah
hota hai band jeene ka har ek raasta
dushman ko bhi khuda na...
<<DIVIDER>>
seh jaye gar ye sadma to himmat hai baap ki
warna jawan ke saath hi mayyat hai baap ki
mayyat jaean ki goya janaza hai baap ka
dushman ko bhi khuda na...
<<DIVIDER>>
humraah tere hogaya ruqsat hamara chain
ay mere laaal baad tere kab raha hussain
sheh ne jawan ki laash pe nauha yehi padha
dushman ko bhi khuda na...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil tukde tukde hogaya kisko dikhaun mai
kya kaifiat hai rooh ki kisko sunaun mai
ye keh ke khoon bahata hai zehra ka dilruba
dushman ko bhi khuda na...
<<DIVIDER>>
hasrat thi sar pe sehra sajaunga mere laal
haathon se apne dulha banaunga mere laal
armaan saare khaak huwe wa musibata
dushman ko bhi khuda na...
<<DIVIDER>>
awaaz de rahe hai bulaate hai tumko hum
labbaik to kaho tumhe allah ki qasam
yun daagh deke baap ko jao na mehlekha
dushman ko bhi khuda na...
<<DIVIDER>>
har lamha teri yaad satayegi baap ko
tasveer teri khoon rulayegi baap ko
ye daagh leke kaise jiyega pidar tera
dushman ko bhi khuda na...
<<DIVIDER>>
daaghe jawan libaas e zaeefi pinhata hai
dunya ko baap ke liye turbat banata hai
hai lab pe ek baap ke bas itni ilteja
dushman ko bhi khuda na...
<<DIVIDER>>
majboor hoo sunaayi nahi deta kya karoo
khud tum galay se aa mil lago aisa kya karoo
dayam tha baap ka yehi mayyat pe marsiya
dushman ko bhi khuda na...
author: Dayam Najafi
